title: 词汇限制下的语言生成：人类与资源理性模型的比较研究
summary: 研究人类在有限词汇（最低仅250个高频词）下如何回答问题，并与基于大语言模型的贪婪和全局最优采样算法进行比较。人类行为更接近贪婪采样，但高技能者会回溯修正。在强限制下，人类倾向于使用语义轻的词。
summary_en: Investigates how humans answer questions under severe vocabulary constraints (as few as 250 high-frequency words), comparing with greedy and globally optimal sampling using LLMs. Humans resemble greedy sampling, but skilled humans backtrack and revise. Humans lean on semantically light words under high constraint.
